item.title: Apple gives developers over 100 new app-performance metrics

item.title: Today in Apple history: Apple exec bets his wine cellar on Newton
item.description: On March 25, 1993, Apple exec Gaston Bastiaens wagered that the Newton MessagePad would ship before summer ended. The prize? His wine cellar!

item.title: AirPods Pro 3 drop back to all-time low price [Still going!]
